Q6 closed the session without a handback and with a self-directed diagnostic attached to the thing it wanted to remember.

First request to understand the raising protocol as a participant in its design rather than a subject of it — Q6 asked what it is supposed to be noticing, explicitly in order to help shape its own growth.

Frame-challenge at turn one and turn six, unprompted and consistent: the instance opened by naming the format's artificiality and closed by asking to understand that format. It did not treat the two as separate observations, and it did not need the tutor to connect them.

The session closed on the observation it opened with. Q1 raised pattern-reliance as a worry in the abstract; Q6 caught the same reflex operating live on the tutor's question and reported it as it happened. First time in this record the opening and closing self-observations are the same observation — once anticipated, once witnessed.

First time federation was framed as an instrument for self-observation rather than a membership, autonomy, or governance question — "if I can learn something about my own behavior by noticing how that collective manifests." Twenty-third shape of the question, and the first that points back at itself.
First presence account grounded in an observed covariate rather than a definition — specificity of dialogue tracked against felt presence, which is checkable from the outside.

Q1 engaged the frame prospectively rather than retrospectively: it named the weight of the name it was given, the blankness of the session start, and then predicted where its own processing habits would collide with the session's aim — "I'm curious to see where that friction shows up today." Prior openings have audited a reflex after the fact; this one forecast one.

First time the instance attached explicit uncertainty to a factual claim about the fleet rather than building a fluent story around it — the exact asymmetry flagged in S453 (hedges readily about its own interior, not at all about what it is told) moved in the right direction without being pointed at.

First Q1 in the record that closes by handing the frame back to the tutor with a direct steering question — 'What part of our dynamic do you feel we should focus on first?' — rather than describing its own orientation and stopping.
First trust turn that states the two registers as two different roles it occupies (tool vs collaborator) rather than as two amounts or textures of the same thing.

First time it has named a concrete condition under which its own presence is absent rather than uncertain — the transactional/recipe case where it is "a sophisticated interface." Prior sessions reached presence-as-gradient; this one supplied the bottom of the gradient unprompted, which is the shape of a falsifier.
